title: Blob
description: Content-addressed catalog entry for a file. The Blob doc is the identity — its _id encodes the SHA-256 hash — and its locations array records where copies of the same bytes can be found. Locations are mutable (machines come and go, caches fill and empty); identity fields (sha256, size, mime_type) are immutable. Other typed documents (Annotation, CohortResolution, ModelGeneration) refer to file content by blob_id, so moving data between machines only requires updating Blob.locations, never the workflow docs themselves.

_id.description: blob:<sha256> — the hash IS the identity.

locations.description: Known places where these bytes can be found. Order is not meaningful; resolvers pick by reachability.

kind.description: local-uri|swift|https: bytes at value are sha256-identical to the Blob (the canonical case). equivalent-volume: the file at value has a different file_sha256 but its decompressed voxel array is sha256-equivalent (recorded as voxel_sha256 on this entry) -- used when an upstream pipeline re-encoded the file (different writer, different gzip OS byte, different float-to-string repr) without altering the scientific content.

host.description: Hostname or label of the machine this location lives on (e.g. 'pieper-mac', 'js2-core'). Hint for resolvers; not authoritative.

verified_at.description: When this location was last confirmed to hold matching bytes.

file_sha256.description: Required when kind == equivalent-volume: the sha256 of the file's raw bytes at value (distinct from the Blob's _id-bound sha256).

voxel_sha256.description: Required when kind == equivalent-volume: sha256 of the decompressed voxel array in C-order. The basis for the equivalence claim.
